author: Shri Raghavendra Swami
commentary: पदं मोक्ष गच्छन्तीत्युक्त्या ज्ञानफलं विवृत्तं ज्ञेयम्
translation: V. Renouncing........Karma means and includes renouncing the fruit of Karma, the wish for it, &c. Those (1) who practise the Yoga or such duties only as are offered to the Lord, (2) who form a true insight into the Sâstras see the Lord and His Greatness, (3) who by virtue of these gain knowledge attain wisdom or direct perception of the Truth,-- those become liberated from the bonds of birth and attain to the goal, the Moksha, where there is no fear of misery. The first two clauses state the means, viz., the discharge of duties free of motives and the perfect and accurate understanding of the Sâstras. The remaining clauses state the results, vis, Wisdom and its fruit, the Moksha. (51.)
